rows.text: Edgar never has to be cast. His eminence works from the command zone: every other Vampire spell you cast brings a free 1/1 Vampire token with it. Thirty-four Vampires here, all but three costing four mana or less, so from turn one every creature you cast is two bodies — and the lords pump the tokens too. Removal aimed at your commander does nothing, because the engine was never on the battlefield.
The deck also wins on the spot with any of six two-card drain combos — see the combos.
It only counts Vampires you CAST. Bloodghast returning from the graveyard, the Demonic Tutor copy from Emeritus of Woe and the Exsanguinate copy from Stensian Sanguinist make no token.

rows.name: Edgar Markov
rows.text: eminence makes a 1/1 black Vampire whenever you cast another Vampire, with Edgar on the battlefield or still in the command zone. Casting him is the late-game bonus: six mana for first strike, haste, and a +1/+1 counter on every Vampire each time he attacks.

rows.name: Cavern of Souls
rows.text: name Vampire: Vampire spells cast with its coloured mana can't be countered, and it taps for any colour to cast them.

rows.name: Voldaren Estate
rows.text: pay 1 life for any colour to cast a Vampire; late game it turns spare mana into Blood tokens.

rows.name: Three Tree City
rows.text: name Vampire, then {2} and a tap makes one mana of a colour for every Vampire you control.

rows.name: Herald's Horn
rows.text: name Vampire: each one costs one less, and each of your upkeeps a Vampire on top of your library goes to your hand.

guide.title: Lords — the tokens get pumped too

rows.name: Legion Lieutenant
rows.text: two mana: other Vampires +1/+1.

rows.name: Stromkirk Captain
rows.text: other Vampires +1/+1 and first strike.

rows.name: Captivating Vampire
rows.text: other Vampires +1/+1, and tapping five Vampires steals any creature for good.

rows.name: Markov Baron
rows.text: other Vampires +1/+1. Convoke lets your tokens help cast it.

rows.name: Edgar, Charmed Groom
rows.text: other Vampires +1/+1. When it dies it returns as a coffin that makes a lifelink Vampire each of your upkeeps and turns back into Edgar after three.

rows.name: Shared Animosity
rows.text: every attacking Vampire gets +1/+0 for each OTHER attacking Vampire. Ten attackers each get +9/+0.

rows.name: Drana, Liberator of Malakir
rows.text: a first-strike flier. When it connects, every attacking creature gets a +1/+1 counter before regular damage is dealt.

rows.name: Exquisite Blood
rows.text: whenever an opponent loses life, you gain that much. With Sanguine Bond, Vito or Marauding Blight-Priest out, every point you gain makes an opponent lose life and every point they lose makes you gain — one drain from anything kills the whole table.

rows.name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
rows.text: the same ability as Exquisite Blood, on a 5/5 flying deathtouch Vampire, so casting it also makes an Edgar token.

rows.name: Sanguine Bond
rows.text: whenever you gain life, an opponent loses that much — the other half of the loop. Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose and Marauding Blight-Priest do the same job, so there are six pairs in all.

Start the loop with any drain: Cruel Celebrant, Blood Artist, a Sanctum Seeker attack, Creeping Bloodsucker's upkeep ping or a lifelink hit. Forerunner of the Legion finds the Vampire halves; Emeritus of Woe's Demonic Tutor finds Exquisite Blood or Sanguine Bond.

rows.name: Diabolic Intent
rows.text: sacrifice a token to find whichever half you are missing.

rows.name: Beseech the Mirror
rows.text: any card. Bargain a token and a card costing 4 or less — Vito or Marauding Blight-Priest — is cast for free; Exquisite Blood, Sanguine Bond and Bloodthirsty Conqueror go to your hand.

rows.name: Sanctum Seeker
rows.text: every Vampire that attacks makes each opponent lose 1 and you gain 1. Twelve attackers is 12 from everyone before blockers.

rows.name: Bloodletter of Aclazotz
rows.text: during your turn, opponents lose twice as much life — combat damage included. Sanctum Seeker, Cruel Celebrant and your whole attack double.

rows.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
rows.text: whenever you gain life, one opponent loses that much. Every drain here gains you life, so each one hits a second time.

rows.name: Marauding Blight-Priest
rows.text: whenever you gain life, each opponent loses 1. With Sanctum Seeker, Vito and Bloodletter all out, each attacking Vampire costs every opponent 4 life and one of them 2 more.

rows.name: Cruel Celebrant
rows.text: whenever one of your creatures dies, each opponent loses 1 and you gain 1.

rows.name: Blood Artist
rows.text: whenever ANY creature dies, a player of your choice loses 1 and you gain 1.

rows.name: Malakir Bloodwitch
rows.text: when it enters, each opponent loses 1 life per Vampire you control, and you gain it all.

rows.name: Stensian Sanguinist
rows.text: whenever you attack, a creature gets deathtouch; if it connects, the Sanguinist becomes prepared and you can cast a copy of Exsanguinate for {X}{B}{B} — X from each opponent, all of it back to you.

rows.name: Creeping Bloodsucker
rows.text: 1 damage to each opponent each of your upkeeps, and you gain it back.

rows.name: Twilight Prophet
rows.text: once you control ten permanents, each of your upkeeps you take the top card and drain everyone for its mana value.

rows.name: Voldaren Epicure
rows.text: a one-drop that pings each opponent and leaves a Blood token.

rows.name: Viscera Seer
rows.text: a free sacrifice outlet. In response to a sweeper, sacrifice everything: Blood Artist and Cruel Celebrant drain for every creature, so sacrifice them last; Cordial Vampire and Elenda grow whatever survives.

rows.name: Cordial Vampire
rows.text: whenever any creature dies, every Vampire you control gets a +1/+1 counter.

rows.name: Elenda, the Dusk Rose
rows.text: grows with every creature that dies, then leaves that many lifelink Vampires when it dies.

rows.name: Indulgent Aristocrat
rows.text: {2} and a sacrifice: a +1/+1 counter on every Vampire.

rows.name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
rows.text: haste, grows as their creatures die, and sacrifices another creature to become indestructible.

rows.name: Bloodghast
rows.text: comes back from the graveyard whenever a land enters under your control.

rows.name: Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet
rows.text: lifelink, and their nontoken creatures that die are exiled and become your 2/2 Zombies.

rows.name: Necropotence
rows.text: skip your draw step, then pay 1 life for each card you want, delivered at end of turn. The drains pay it back.

rows.name: Skullclamp
rows.text: equip it to a creature with 1 toughness and it dies: two cards for one mana. A lord that adds toughness keeps your tokens alive, so pick an X/1.

rows.name: Black Market Connections
rows.text: each first main phase, pick any of: a Treasure for 1 life, a card for 2, a 3/2 changeling for 3. Changelings are every creature type, so the token counts as a Vampire for your lords and Sanctum Seeker.

rows.name: Welcoming Vampire
rows.text: once a turn, a card when creatures with power 2 or less enter — most of your tokens do, until lords push them past 2 power.

rows.name: Champion of Dusk
rows.text: when it enters, draw a card and lose 1 life for each Vampire you control.

rows.name: Florian, Voldaren Scion
rows.text: after combat, look at one card per point of life your opponents lost this turn, and play one of them.

rows.name: Scheming Silvertongue
rows.text: a flying lifelinker. If you gained 2 life before your second main phase, it lets you cast a copy of Sign in Blood for {B}{B}.

rows.name: Emeritus of Woe
rows.text: a 5/4 that enters prepared: you may cast a copy of Demonic Tutor for {1}{B} at sorcery speed. It prepares again at your end step if two or more creatures died that turn, but never holds more than one copy.

rows.name: Forerunner of the Legion
rows.text: puts any Vampire on top of your library, then pumps a creature whenever another Vampire enters.

rows.name: Smothering Tithe
rows.text: every card an opponent draws is two mana from them or a Treasure for you.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: the fastest start.

rows.name: Arcane Signet
rows.text: any of your three colours.

rows.name: Talisman of Hierarchy
rows.text: white or black.

rows.name: Talisman of Indulgence
rows.text: black or red.

rows.name: Talisman of Conviction
rows.text: red or white.

rows.name: Vault of the Archangel
rows.text: {2}{W}{B} gives your whole team deathtouch and lifelink — with Vito out, every lifelink hit drains the same amount again, and Marauding Blight-Priest adds 1 per hit.

rows.name: Swords to Plowshares
rows.text: one mana, any creature.

rows.name: Path to Exile
rows.text: the second one.

rows.name: Terminate
rows.text: two mana, no regeneration.

rows.name: Anguished Unmaking
rows.text: any nonland permanent for 3 life.

rows.name: Deadly Rollick
rows.text: exile a creature. Free only while Edgar is on the battlefield; four mana otherwise.

rows.name: Chaos Warp
rows.text: the red answer to anything.

rows.name: Bloodtithe Harvester
rows.text: a 3/2 for two that later sacrifices itself to shrink a creature by twice your Blood tokens.

rows.name: Olivia's Wrath
rows.text: a one-sided sweeper: every non-Vampire gets -X/-X, where X is how many Vampires you control.

rows.name: Teferi's Protection
rows.text: the whole board phases out until your next turn.

rows.name: Clever Concealment
rows.text: phases out any of your nonland permanents; convoke means your tokens pay for it.

rows.name: Flawless Maneuver
rows.text: your creatures are indestructible. Free only while Edgar is on the battlefield; three mana otherwise.

rows.name: Boros Charm
rows.text: indestructible for everything, or 4 damage to a player.

rows.name: Akroma's Will
rows.text: flying, vigilance and double strike, or lifelink, indestructible and protection from every colour — both with Edgar on the battlefield.

rows.name: Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord
rows.text: deathtouch and lifelink each turn, or sacrifice a Vampire for 3 damage; −3 puts a Vampire from your hand straight onto the battlefield.

rows.name: Grand Abolisher
rows.text: during your turn, opponents can't cast spells or use abilities of artifacts, creatures or enchantments — the loop resolves in peace.

rows.name: Voice of Victory
rows.text: your opponents can't cast spells during your turn, and it brings two attacking Warriors when it attacks.

rows.name: Silence
rows.text: one mana and nobody else casts spells this turn. Cast it before you start the loop.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep two or three lands and at least two cheap Vampires. A one-drop on turn one is two bodies; a one-drop and a two-drop on turn three is four more.
Don't cast Edgar until you need him. The tokens come from the command zone; cast him when six mana has nothing better to do, or when his attack counters win the game.
Play around sweepers. Past five or six creatures, hold Viscera Seer, Teferi's Protection or Clever Concealment before adding more.
Necropotence costs life, and so does Black Market Connections. Count your life against what the table can do to you before paying.
